payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP counting distinct subsequences by length using prefix index and subsequence length, with deduplication based on last occurrence of each character.
payload.rationale: The solution computes dp[i][j] = number of distinct subsequences of length j from first i characters, using recurrence dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i-1][j-1] minus duplicates via pos[v] tracking. This is a classic 2D DP over prefix and length.
